generic_inputs.value: Design monospaced 18x20 bitmap glyph systems for a machine-vision reading challenge. Historical inspiration: High Middle Ages Germanic/Gothic scriptorium hands, especially early Gothic/Textura traits, but OCR/vision separability and deterministic pixel rendering dominate historical ornament. Fixed cell geometry is 18 pixels wide x 20 pixels high. Produce concrete bitmap data or compact deterministic JavaScript capable of generating exact 18x20 bitmaps without installed fonts.

evaluation_heuristic: Act as a bitmap type designer and machine-vision readability engineer. Construct three distinct 18x20 monospaced Gothic/Germanic manuscript-inspired font candidates ordered from most OCR-safe to most stylistically Gothic. Every demonstrated glyph must be exactly 18 columns by 20 rows. Prioritize disambiguation of I/l/1, O/0, rn/m, c/e, braces/parentheses, straight/curly quote/backtick, slash/backslash, and punctuation used by Markdown, JSON, and code. Give concrete machine-consumable JavaScript/bitmap data, not names of existing fonts or general advice. Keep candidates compact enough to fit the response; use a deterministic procedural representation if that avoids dumping thousands of literal bitmap rows. Include a preview string for comparing candidates.

candidates.name: string
candidates.javascript: complete self-contained JavaScript implementing the candidate glyph renderer or glyph map
